Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Black Fortress Bass Distortion $ 199.00 Select option Select option THREE WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 199.00 Add to cart View cart The Black Fortress started out as an HM-2 inspired bass distortion. HM-2? What? Isn't that shit overplayed in the game now? Well not this one. It has evolved into it's own unique BEAST set for maximum beef and grind! -MASTER is the main "HM-2" section output volume control. -DRIVE controls -MASTER distortion and -OCT fuzz intensities. -LOW, -MID and -HIGH are the classic HM-2 tone controls. -OCT is the parallel mixed analog octave volume control. -DIR and -PASS are the same killer clean blend with separate low pass filter to help round out the huge sound of this BEAST with amazing Krull inspired artwork by Diablo Macabre! I had bass in mind when I came up with this, but it also sounds KILLER on guitar or Synth! SPECS: Large and in charge 7.38" x 4.70" x 1.30" sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9-18vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input only. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "Sir, it is amazing. I have a variety of HM2 and octave pedals, but none do what this does. The Black Fortress snaps and clangs like there’s an armor-plated battalion of the Devil’s own legionnaires storming up out of Hell. It is saturated, but it grinds and growls. Satan’s pitbull doesn’t sound meaner. It is a triumph. It replaces several pedals that, stacked, don’t sound like this does on its own. It made me want to strangle my guitar and punch riffs." -Jeremy H.
